title: Tanvi Patri Wins U17 Badminton Asia Junior Championships Title
indian_angle: An Indian player secured a major junior title in an all-Indian final, showcasing the depth of talent.
summary: Odisha's Tanvi Patri defeated Shaina Manimuthu in an all-Indian final to clinch the U17 title at the Badminton Asia Junior Championships.

title: Pramod Bags Gold, Silver; Sukant Reaches 100-Medal Mark in Japan Para-Badminton
indian_angle: Indian para-badminton stars continue to shine internationally, with Pramod winning multiple medals and Sukant achieving a career milestone.
summary: Indian para-badminton players Pramod Bhagat and Sukant Kadam achieved significant success in Japan, with Bhagat securing gold and silver, and Kadam completing his 100-medal haul.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Begins in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course is crucial for developing coaching talent across India, strengthening the grassroots and advanced training infrastructure.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has commenced its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, running from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships Underway
indian_angle: This camp prepares India's promising young shuttlers for major continental junior championships, fostering future champions.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BAI Adopts 3x15 Scoring for Domestic Junior Tournaments and Nationals
indian_angle: This rule change will impact how junior domestic tournaments are played, potentially influencing player development and match strategies.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for U13, U15, and U17 age groups in domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships.

title: Final Selection Trials for BWF World Junior Championships 2026 Announced
indian_angle: This notification outlines the crucial final steps for Indian junior players aiming to represent the country at the prestigious World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the list of eligible players and details for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026, to be held in Cairo, Egypt.
